paragraphs.text: Hello, I am Ke Liu (also Coco Liu), an undergraduate student in the School of Mathematics at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, and an incoming Ph.D. student at Renmin University of China.
My research focuses on deep learning, graph neural networks, and computational pathology, particularly whole slide image (WSI) analysis. I am also interested in machine learning and AI agents.
In my spare time, I enjoy photography, table tennis, hiking, mountaineering, and exploring beautiful landscapes.

quote.text: Dear friend, life always holds a brighter turn ahead.
quote.author: My motto
